text:
Customer: Hey team - getting 403 on our production calls since this morning. We haven't changed keys. Response is: 

{
  "error": "entitlement_required",
  "message": "access denied"
}

Customer says SDK v1.2.3 used, same config as always. Pls advise.

Anita (Support): thanks — can you paste a redacted curl? also which plan (team/enterprise) and org id?

Customer: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx' -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hi"}' 
org: org_7Qx
plan: team monthly

Anita (Support): repro log noted. 403 body matches entitlement gating not auth, but error text is confusing. pinging SRE + billing.

Mike (SRE): putting on my screen. Quick check: token validation passed (signature + scope). I see a 403 returned from entitlement service: product_check -> DENY for product_id=prod_legacy_text. That product_id doesn't match customer's billed sku (prod_team_text). Looks like the entitlement service is referencing the wrong product mapping.

PJ (Platform): interesting — we recently added a feature-flag path to allow per-sdk product mapping for older SDKs. Could be a regression in fallback mapping. Any recent deploys?

OpsBot: deploy pipeline: platform/api-gatekeeper v2.17.1 deployed 2026-03-01T09:10Z to prod. Triggered rollout on all regions.

Sara (Billing): customer org_7Qx is active on team monthly, not legacy. No billing issues.

Anita (Support): preliminary narrative: customer sees 403 that looks like auth failure but is actually entitlement check failing because product mapping resolved to legacy product id. Need exact repro steps to confirm.

Mike (SRE): repro steps I used:
1) use customer's API key (redacted) in a request to /v1/generate
2) watch auth service logs: token validated ok
3) observe entitlement request outbound: POST /entitlement/check {org_id: org_7Qx, product_id: prod_legacy_text} -> response {allowed: false}

Sample log snippet:
```
[auth] token_ok sk-xxxx -> sub=org_7Qx
[gatekeeper] product_lookup sdk_client=python-1.2.3 -> product_id=prod_legacy_text
[entitlement] check org=org_7Qx product=prod_legacy_text -> deny
[http] 403 {"error":"entitlement_required","message":"access denied"}
```

PJ (Platform): repro confirmed. Looks like the sdk_client -> product mapping table omitted the entry for python-1.2.3, so it fell back to legacy behavior. That fallback uses prod_legacy_text which is gated.

Anita (Support): action items? Customer impact: blocked since 09:05 UTC, affecting 2 endpoints, high priority.

PJ (Platform): quick fix: add explicit mapping for python-1.2.3 -> prod_team_text in platform config and reload mapping. Doing now.

(5 minutes pass)

PJ (Platform): pushed mapping change, reloaded. Can someone ask customer to retry?

Anita (Support): DMing customer to retry.

Customer: retried — success! 200 and response streaming. Thanks. :tada:

Anita (Support): great. Root cause: regression in feature-flagged mapping logic caused older SDK user-agent strings to fall back to a legacy product id; entitlement service denied access because org isn't subscribed to legacy product. Because response error used generic 403 with message "access denied", customer assumed API key was revoked.

Mike (SRE): follow-ups:
- add a monitoring alert when entitlement service returns DENY for product_id that doesn't match org's known sku (mismatch anomaly).
- add unit/regression tests for mapping fallback logic (cover several SDK version patterns).
- add a more descriptive error payload for entitlement failures: include code e.g., `entitlement_mismatch` and include product_id (redacted) and suggested next steps.

PJ (Platform): also will add mapping to default explicitly for any unrecognized sdk_client to map to 'unknown_sdk' product which will short-circuit and return a 400 with guidance instead of 403.

Sara (Billing): update docs for support to include checklist: if 403 with entitlement_required -> check billing sku match -> check mapping table -> escalate to platform. Will prepare a KB.

Anita (Support): I will send customer a follow-up explaining cause and link to KB. Also attach timeline and fix.

Customer: thanks everyone, appreciate the fast turnaround.

PJ (Platform): postmortem items created: M-2026-03-15-001. Added regression test, mapping change, and alert.

Anita (Support): closing thread after KB published.

(Reaction: :white_check_mark: from Sara)
